overall_reason: One UI sans (Segoe UI drawn at 1440, from a -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI" stack; system-ui at 375) sets every role, which fits a product component in Operate mode, so TYP-005 does not apply. Column heads (10px/400) and data (13px/500) are set well, but at 1440 the Size column is cut by the frame: the head 'Size' is cut short and the value '4.2' loses 'MB'. The 16px caption above the frame is the capture's page furniture and is left out of the judgment.

score.reason: T-LEADING fails on clipped glyphs at 1440 (TYP-022, Floor, caps the score at 4); T-LADDER and T-FIGURES pass and the 375 capture shows the full column.

findings.title: Lines never collide or clip
findings.where: Size column of the Projects window, 1440
findings.evidence: The DOM value is '4.2 MB' (13px/500); the screenshot shows '4.2' with the unit cut at the frame edge and the head 'Size' cut (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png, right edge). At 375 the column is whole (01-evidence/tiles/375-00.png).
findings.before: Value and column head cut at the frame edge at 1440
findings.after: Narrow the columns or the window so the last column ends inside the visible frame at every width
findings.why: The reader sees a size with no unit and cannot read the column head.

strengths: Data cells at 13px/500 stand clearly above 10px column heads.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width (type table measure.paragraphs = 0)
